messages:
maria-g: heads up — ran into a weird parity issue between the python SDK and the js helper for rerank batching. python returns `embedding.shape=(N,512)` while js helper sets `vector_size:512` in the response body and our sampleapp expects `dims` :facepalm:
kevin-l: ugh. which endpoint/version? rerank v1 or embeddings v2?
samir: looks like rerank v1. pattern: when batch size is 1 python flattens to [512] and js keeps [[512]] — sampleapp panics on access.
olga: can you paste a minimal repro? afaict our client helpers should normalize to `vectors: [[...]]` and `dim: 512` top-level.
maria-g: repro: call code below (python):
```
resp = client.rerank.batch([{'query': q, 'documents': docs}])
print(resp['embeddings'])
```
prints e.g. `[0.13, 0.02, ...]` instead of `[[0.13,...]]`.
kevin-l: that smells like the SDK unwrap-on-singleton behavior we added for convenience. It breaks idempotent batching across transports. we added it in py to match old clients but never updated sampleapp.
samir: also noticed auth retry can duplicate small batches: our retry wrapper retries the entire batch on a 429, but the batching helper sometimes requeues items and you end up with duplicates. short term workaround: attach `X-Request-ID` per logical request and de-dupe server-side.
maria-g: can we add a quick fix in the SDK: always keep embedding arrays 2D and add `request_id` in headers? patch I sketched:
```
# python SDK: before returning
if hasattr(resp, 'embeddings'):
  if isinstance(resp['embeddings'][0], float):
    resp['embeddings'] = [resp['embeddings']]
headers['X-Request-ID'] = request_id
```
not pretty but avoids breaking sampleapps.
olga: pls don't mutate raw resp. prefer wrapping layer: `normalize_embeddings(resp)` in helpers. and add unit tests for batch_size==1.
kevin-l: agree. also we should change js helper to emit `meta.dim` and `vectors` canonical shape. that will help the quickstart sampleapps.
samir: for retries: add an idempotency key per logical request and make retry library send `Idempotency-Key` so server can guard. I'll open a small RFC.
ci-bot: deploy-pipeline: new PR 4792 added to queue (maria-g/normalize-embeddings).
maria-g: thanks, will open PR with tests + changelog entry. also adding a small note in the sampleapp README: "embedding shapes may be 1D for single-item batches; use helper.normalize_embeddings()".
kevin-l: excellent. follow-up: let's audit other helpers for similar unwrap behavior (`scores`, `tokens`). low effort + big UX win.
olga: filing a devex task for the audit. tagging: @samir @maria-g.
samir: cool — I'll prototype Idempotency-Key header behavior and a tiny server-side guard. should reduce dupes from retries.
maria-g: thanks team. landed workaround in sampleapp for now, will re-run integration tests after CI passes. :thumbsup:
